extra.summary: Now packed with even more miles, DBS Altitude Card is one of the best entry-level miles credit cards in Singapore. With up to 2.2 miles per S$1 on your spend, it’s the fastest way to turn your life into Miles for Life. It also offers 1 year annual fee waiver, 10,000 bonus miles when you pay for your annual fee and amazing travel deals.

our_takes.our-take: The DBS Altitude Amex is best for those who prefer straightforward miles accumulation. You get 1.3 miles per S$1 locally and up to 2.2 miles overseas. A key advantage is that DBS Points don't expire, offering flexibility in redemption. Priority Pass gives you 2 complimentary lounge visits annually, useful for occasional travellers. Consider if the S$196.20 annual fee (waived with S$25,000 spend) and S$27.25 conversion fee are worth it against your spending habits. Note that DCC foreign transactions are treated as local spend, affecting your miles earned.
our_takes.good-for:
Miles chasers who want accelerated miles on overseas spending and enjoy complimentary airport lounge access during travels.
Young working adults who want to earn miles on daily expenditure to redeem on their own terms, with no miles expiry.
People who frequently book hotels at Agoda, seeking to maximize miles earnings on their accommodations.
our_takes.things-to-note:
S$27.25 conversion fee applies each time you convert DBS Points to miles, consider if it's worth it.
Annual fee of S$196.20 is only waived if you spend S$25,000, a significant amount.
Foreign transaction fees are 3.25%; factor this into overseas spending for maximum miles.
